svg.text: Chest lifecycle · Earn → unlock → wait → reveal
Module 03 · Sheet 1/2 · 12 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
Four slots; one running timer; default Silver Chest 3h. Free wait is always available. Server timestamp controls readiness; contents granted exactly once on open.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
